notes.title: SNIPER ELITE V2 REMASTERED Launches May 14th - Upgrade Discount Confirmed
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34794722/b938a9df5da091198e4c7013030e0d0ae77678e3.jpg

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nKB1ioeA988

Independent developer and publisher Rebellion today announced an official release date for Sniper Elite V2 Remastered on Steam.

The hotly anticipated remaster of the studio’s 2012 classic will launch on digital storefronts May 14th. Fans can pre-order Sniper Elite V2 Remastered from today and take advantage of a special 10% discount on the digital edition ahead of launch.

Discount for owners confirmed!
We are delighted to reveal that Steam users who already own the original edition of Sniper Elite V2 can upgrade to Sniper Elite V2 Remastered for just £6.99/$9.99/€9.99.

Sniper Elite V2 Remastered features beautifully updated environments, characters, weapons and vehicles, modernized rendering and post-processing effects, enhanced texturing and level geometry, a revamped lighting system, and dozens upon dozens of improvements and refinements. 

In addition to visual upgrades, Sniper Elite V2 Remastered introduces a brand new frame-by-frame photo mode, seven new playable characters from Rebellion’s Zombie Army series, expanded multiplayer for up to 16 players online, and all the additional content ever released for the game, FREE. 

Sniper Elite V2 Remastered is available to pre-order from today for £29.99/$34.99/€34.99, with a special 10% discount until launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/728740/Sniper_Elite_V2_Remastered/

notes.title: The True History of the Strange Brigade!
notes.content:
Good day, fine adventurers of the Strange Brigade, we have exciting news!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/8b832e717ef7907d29420fe021ede4d70e1e25ff.jpg

You may have heard word of The True History of the Strange Brigade, an anthology fiction title based upon the game, but we're thrilled to announce that it's out now in the UK, available to buy on Amazon and Waterstones! Find out more below...

[code]A TIME FOR HEROES!

A SAFARI INTO DANGER!

FIVE RIP-ROARING NEW ADVENTURES!

There are remote corners of the British Empire where the supernatural lurks and the shadows linger, where few dare go and fewer return. This is the world of the little-known Department of Antiquities – the so-called “Strange Brigade” – tasked with confronting ancient and terrible evils that threaten us all. But who are these mysterious adventurers? 

Marvel at these never before heard tales of our fearless and unflinching heroes…

Bringing together rising stars Cassandra Khaw, Gaie Sebold, Tauriq Moosa, Guy Adams and Jonathan L. Howard, The True History of the Strange Brigade delves into the hidden origins of some of the Brigade's finest, giving gamers and readers alike a unique opportunity to understand and engage with the characters.[/code]

Spiffing! Like the sound of this? You can purchase using the links below:
Amazon: https://www.amazon.co.uk/True-History-Strange-Brigade/dp/1781086109/ref=sr_1_3?ie=UTF8&qid=1533809013&sr=8-3&keywords=strange+brigade

Waterstones: https://www.waterstones.com/book/the-true-history-of-the-strange-brigade/david-moore/9781781086100

Still not sure? Fear not, we've got you covered. We're also delighted to offer you a free excerpt of an entire chapter to download - which tells the story of our tough Lancashire lass - Gracie Braithwaite!

Download the excerpt here: http://strange-content.rebellion.co.uk/Strange_Brigade_Extract.pdf

The True History of the Strange Brigade also launches in the United States on August 28th, at the same time as the game. Marvellous!

notes.title: Brand new modes announced!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/732ccaf65adc9fc846cd08e433e6645dc072c973.png

With just three weeks until the launch of Strange Brigade, we’re excited to lift the sarcophagus lid on two very exciting surprises: Score Attack and Horde Mode!

These two modes – playable in single-player or two-four player – will be available FREE at launch, and we’re delighted to confirm that both will receive free content updates post-launch!

So what are these modes? Read on adventurer, and find out…

SCORE ATTACK – WHERE SPEED MEETS PANACHE…
Score Attack is a fast-paced mode, all about cutting through large numbers of enemies with as much speed and style as you can, in an attempt to keep that combo-multiplier as high as possible! As you might expect, this ticks up as you take down your enemies in quick succession, but will deplete should you take too long to score a kill!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/81d7a01c6552ec701e6613add44053e6aac56bbe.jpg

As well as this, there are also big bonus points up for grabs – such as not taking any damage, racking up the headshots, and other devilish challenges to keep you coming back for more.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/cf1ab10dda9d07183d20e8e4f0118c00f8715a9d.jpg

We cannot wait for you try Score Attack – it’s a fast-paced challenge with plenty of opportunities to show off your skills!

HORDE MODE, WITH A ‘STRANGE’ TWIST!
Horde Mode may seem familiar at first, but the crack team at Rebellion worked their magic to take some of the core gameplay mechanics and reinterpret them in to a fresh new mode!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/36550a9f513d0afa6ae6834fd96c571b6ad11309.jpg

Similar to spending gold in the campaign to unlock new weapons, special weapons and more, in Horde Mode you accumulate gold by killing enemies – but how do you spend it? Do you splash the cash on the Flamethrower, knowing once it runs out of gas it’s done, or do you save your gold to open up new parts of the level to potentially unlock more goodies like health potions or loot? 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/544fe9f8168fb9ad097554f623277152ee915a28.jpg

This neat change helps to create a thrilling mode, whether you’re playing solo or with 2-4 players, full of tactical decisions to be made in the face of an unending horde of nefarious ne’er do wells…

IN THE NEXT EXCITING EPISODE OF THE STRANGE BRIGADE…
There you go, keen adventurers. We’re thrilled to be able to show this off and we can’t wait for you to get playing! Check out the brand new screenshots to get your first taste of Score Attack and Horde mode!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/e8b82774a443888b208cfdd65337e2e6f84aff2d.jpg

Which mode are you most excited for? Come and join the conversation on  Twitter,  Facebook and  Discord

notes.title: Character Biographies!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/382e6da36c5beb7fddd24da240a9d4963c95bcf5.jpg
What ho, adventurer!

With the launch of Strange Brigade on the horizon (well, August 28th to be specific), we thought it high time you acquaint yourself a bit better with the four fearless adventurers that make up the brigade. From back story to loadout, read on to find out details about each character, as well as how they came to be a member of the Strange Brigade… 

Nalangu Rushida

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/c7c92e76efba2fdd64e47a84b5f4ccf82fdbf1d2.jpg

Years of harsh training hunting demons has bestowed Nalangu with rapid reflexes and a sixth sense for danger!

DEFAULT LOADOUTPrimary: Chamberlain Automatic Rifle
Secondary: Marley .45 Automatic
Item: Molotov Cocktail
DEFAULT AMULET POWER
Blazing Wrath of Ra: Harness the power of the sun god Ra. Leap in to the air then bring down a radial blast of fire!

ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIESFast Movement: Overall movement speed is increased.
Vampire Strike: Nalangu receives a small amount of health from each successful melee hit.
BACK STORY
Raised from birth to protect her people from supernatural threats, it was only when she underwent the ritual trials to become a full Spirit-Warrior that Nalangu learned her destiny lay elsewhere. Following this new path led her to Lady Imelda Webster. Since joining the Brigade, she has travelled across Africa to hone her Spirit-Warrior skills and bested beasts and demons from across the globe.

Frank Fairburne

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/d7afb4e492ef56b2840f7bbea5bc49893684d617.jpg

A lifetime of service in the army has left Frank with a tough exterior … oh and a rather brutal headshot!

DEFAULT LOADOUT
Primary: Westminster 1895
Secondary: Marley .45 Automatic
Item: Dynamite
DEFAULT AMULET POWER
Chariot Charge: Charge in to your enemies with devastating force, knocking them flying and exploding on contact with the ground!

ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIES
Tough Hide: Frank’s overall health is increased.
Super Headshot: Headshots are explosive!
BACK STORY
A veteran sharpshooter described as ‘the man with the coldest eyes in the Empire’ by his commanding officers, Frank’s seen a lot during his time on clandestine operations. However it was his assassination of a demonic cult leader in the Khyber Pass that brought him to the Brigade’s attention. Not that he knew it at the time! Motivated more by money than honour, Frank is a deadly addition to any expedition.

Gracie Braithwaite 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/b6a6819840ba1abac8711be56c5700047b66271d.jpg

The Lancashire Lass with a dab hand for explosive & fisticuffs. Remarkably useful in close quarter combat!

DEFAULT LOADOUT
Primary: Leamington Model 14
Secondary: Marley .45 Automatic
Item: Grenade
DEFAULT AMULET POWER
Curse of the Mummy’s Tomb: Wrap your foe in spectral bandages. Pull your enemy towards you then fire them forward as an explosive!

ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIES
Fast Explosives: Grenades recharge quicker.
Haymaker: Gracie’s melee attack has a large area of effect.
BACK STORY
Born and raised among the smoke-belching factories and dark satanic mills of northern England gave Gracie all the toughness and no-nonsense attitude she needed to survive. It was when she burned down a textile factory being used by demons to make human skin-suit disguises that she came to the attention of the Strange Brigade. Her blunt way of talking may not be to everyone’s taste, but there’s no denying her effectiveness as a Brigade operative.

Professor Archimedes De Quincey

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/95e94bc8fb795d5e3d753dcbb3ae574551330932.jpg

With his affinity for magic, Archimedes has a wider soul gather radius & the ability to open ancient alcoves!

DEFAULT LOADOUT
Primary: Kingsley Special Repeater
Secondary: Marley .45 Automatic
Item: Sticky grenade
DEFAULT AMULET POWER
All-Consuming Swarm: Summon the power of a cursed scarab swarm. Fire a powerful group of projectiles that home in on enemies, causing damage on contact!

ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIES
Powerful Soul Aura: Able to attract souls at a greater distance.
Keen Secret Finder: Allows Archimedes to see treasure that others cannot see. 
BACK STORY
Noted archaeologist and scholar, unearthing the secrets of the past was De Quincey’s greatest passion. One that would eventually lead to tragedy, when on an expedition to find the Crown of Dagan, his entire party was killed by the evil forces it unleashed. In remorse, he joined the Strange Brigade. Where once he wanted to uncover the secrets of the past, now he wants only to keep the world safe by ensuring these ancient horrors remain forever hidden. 

---

There we have it!
Who is your favourite? Let us know on the comments below or on our  Twitter and  Facebook, also make sure you're signed up to the  Newsletter to be in with a chance of winning a copy of the game!

notes.title: Strange Brigade launching August 28th 2018
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/yKs0YUr.png
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1_q5ox3Jr1c
Have no fear - the intrepid and dashing STRANGE BRIGADE® set off for rip-roaring escapades on August 28th! Rebellion's new 1930s co-op adventure is now available for pre-order including Collector's and Digital Deluxe editions. 
 
As today's brand new story trailer reveals, our four heroes find themselves in exotic, unplumbed corners of Egypt, where ancient terror lingers. Risen from the dead, the Witch Queen Seteki commands an army of mummified monstrosities hell-bent on terror, and only one band of brave adventurers has the gusto to sock ancient evil back into its sarcophagus! Together, the STRANGE BRIGADE® must take on treacherous traps, overcome puzzling predicaments and blast their way through hordes of malevolent monsters in a thrilling campaign for 1-4 players. 

https://i.imgur.com/kr2F56a.jpg

PRE-ORDERS & FREE CONTENT
Would-be adventurers can pre-order STRANGE BRIGADE® starting today. All pre-orders will include the Secret Service Weapons Pack FREE, including the butter-smooth Wilkers & White P19 pistol, the piercingly precise Stoudenmire 960 submachine gun, and the punch-packing, one-of-a-kind Gehrig-Delgane S1 rifle.  
 
Digital discoverers can also pre-order the STRANGE BRIGADE® Deluxe Edition, featuring the game and Season Pass in one great value-for-money bundle. Post-launch Season Pass content will include new campaign missions, characters, weapons, items and more.

https://i.imgur.com/5E7nFv5.jpg 

Find out more at: 
Website -  StrangeBrigade.com	
Twitter -  @strangebrigade
Facebook -  Strange Brigade

About Rebellion®
Founded in 1992, Rebellion is one of Europe's leading independent game developers and publishers. Whether it's the breathtaking intensity of Sniper Elite 4, the face-hugging terror of Aliens vs. Predator or the grindhouse frenzy of Zombie Army Trilogy, the Oxford-based studio is known for creating stand-out games that thrill players.
